items.title: Jobless claims fall to lowest level since July
items.feedTitle: U.S. jobless claims fell to 194,000 last week, lowest since July
items.summary: US jobless claims dropped to 194,000 last week, marking the lowest figure since July and remaining at historically low levels this year, never exceeding 230,000 in a single week. The data suggests continued labor market strength despite economic headwinds. This trend contrasts with broader market concerns about inflation and geopolitical tensions.

items.title: Rising employer health insurance costs hit American workers
items.feedTitle: Workers hit hard by rising employer health insurance costs
items.summary: Costs for workplace-sponsored health insurance are spiking significantly, with the average family plan rising 5% to over $28,000 annually, according to a new survey. Small businesses and their employees are being hit especially hard by these increases. The surge in premiums is putting pressure on household budgets at a critical time.

items.title: Top MAHA ally Calley Means resigns from Trump administration
items.feedTitle: Calley Means, top MAHA ally, resigns from Trump administration
items.summary: Calley Means, a key adviser to RFK Jr. and proponent of the MAHA (Make America Healthy Again) agenda, has resigned from the White House. The departure represents a setback for the administration's health-focused policy initiatives. The timing comes just days before major announcements related to the MAHA agenda.

items.title: Starter home savings now takes twice as long as 2019
items.feedTitle: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
items.summary: A new analysis finds that average renter households now need 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs, double the timeframe from 2019. Rising rents and other living costs have consumed a larger share of household budgets, making homeownership increasingly out of reach. The data underscores deepening affordability challenges for young Americans.

items.title: Voters prioritize costs and Iran over Trump investigations
items.feedTitle: Voters prioritize costs and Iran over investigating Trump for next Congress, AP-NORC poll finds
items.summary: An AP-NORC poll finds voters prioritize economic costs and Iran tensions over investigating Trump for the next Congress. The survey indicates voters are focused on immediate bread-and-butter issues and foreign policy risks rather than partisan investigations. This sentiment could shape the agenda of the incoming Congress.

stlouis.title: ICE agents investigate suspected voter fraud across Missouri
stlouis.feedTitle: With midterms looming, ICE agents investigate suspected voter fraud across Missouri
stlouis.summary: With midterms looming, ICE agents are conducting investigations into suspected noncitizen voting across Missouri. A judge has restricted some DHS investigations into noncitizen voting, citing flawed data used in the inquiries. The enforcement actions raise questions about the scope and accuracy of voter fraud investigations in the state.

stlouis.title: St. Louis CITY SC wins first U.S. Open Cup title
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis CITY SC claims first U.S. Open Cup title in shootout win over Columbus Crew
stlouis.summary: St. Louis CITY SC claimed their first U.S. Open Cup championship in a shootout victory over the Columbus Crew. The win marks a significant milestone for the young MLS franchise. The victory provides a major boost to the team and the St. Louis soccer community.

stlouis.title: Man admits setting metro-east spas fires after sexual encounter
stlouis.feedTitle: Man burned down Metro East massage parlor, killing woman inside, over sexual encounter, investigators say
stlouis.summary: A man has admitted to setting fires at metro-east massage parlors, with investigators saying the fires were motivated by a dispute following a sexual encounter. One of the fires resulted in a death. The ATF's investigation revealed the deliberate nature of the arsons and the tragic human toll.

items.title: Iran reports seven oil tankers attacked in Strait of Hormuz
items.feedTitle: Iran says 7 oil tankers attacked in the Strait of Hormuz as fears grow of a return to war
items.summary: Iran says seven oil tankers were struck in the Strait of Hormuz as tensions escalate in the region. The incidents come amid broader concerns about a possible return to wider conflict between US, Israel, and Iran. Oil prices have jumped in response to the attacks and regional instability.

items.title: Oil surges above $111 as stocks plummet on Iran strike news
items.feedTitle: Oil soars above $111 as stocks plummet on Iran strike news, AI spending concerns
items.summary: Oil prices climbed above $111 per barrel as global stock markets declined sharply on news of potential Iran strikes and AI spending concerns. Stocks tumbled worldwide as investors fled risk assets and sought safety. The combination of geopolitical tension and technology sector weakness drove the broad sell-off.

items.title: France bans some protests in Marseille and Lyon after riots
items.feedTitle: Total ban on protests in Marseille and Lyon after riots
items.summary: French authorities have imposed a total ban on protests in Marseille and Lyon, with protests only permitted in other towns if organized by unions. Top museums will be closed on Saturday as a precautionary measure. The restrictions come after a weekend of violent riots that prompted a tough government response.

items.title: Two killed in Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia airport
items.feedTitle: Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
items.summary: Two people were killed in a Houthi attack on King Fahd airport in eastern Saudi Arabia. The strike is the latest in a series of attacks by the Houthi movement targeting airports and other sites in the kingdom. The US has told some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia amid escalating regional tensions.

items.title: Strong 7.0 magnitude earthquake strikes China's Tibet
items.feedTitle: Earthquake of magnitude 7 strikes China's Tibet
items.summary: A powerful 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck China's Tibet region, causing significant seismic activity. The earthquake is shallow, which typically increases damage potential. The incident follows deadly flash floods that affected the region weeks earlier.

items.title: PM Modi, Netanyahu discuss West Asia situation
items.feedTitle: PM Modi, Netanyahu Discuss West Asia Situation, Reaffirm India-Israel Strategic Partnership
items.summary: PM Modi and Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu discussed the West Asia situation and reaffirmed India-Israel strategic partnership. The call comes amid escalating tensions in the region following reported attacks on tankers and Saudi infrastructure. The dialogue underscores India's balancing act between its security partnership with Israel and broader Middle East stability concerns.

items.title: Face-off with China continues at multiple Arunachal border locations
items.feedTitle: Face-off with China continues at multiple locations along Arunachal border: ITBP D-G
items.summary: The ITBP Director-General reports that face-offs with China continue at multiple locations along the Arunachal Pradesh border. The ITBP chief warns that drones represent the future of warfare and that India cannot face China with traditional weapons alone. Underground shelters are being prioritized as part of new border defense strategies.

items.title: India hosts over half of global capability centres
items.feedTitle: India Hosts Over Half of Global Capability Centres, Ranks Among Top Three AI Ecosystems: PM Modi
items.summary: PM Modi highlighted that India hosts over half of the world's global capability centres and ranks among the top three AI ecosystems globally. The statement underscores India's growing role in the technology and AI landscape. India's tech infrastructure continues to attract multinational investments and talent.

items.title: India seeks details after Houthis target yacht with 14 nationals
items.feedTitle: India seeks details after Houthis allege Saudi forces targeted yacht carrying 14 nationals off Yemen
items.summary: India is seeking details after Houthis allegedly targeted a yacht carrying 14 Indian nationals off Yemen. The Indian embassy is working to ascertain the facts of the incident. The attack raises concerns about Indian citizens caught in escalating Middle East tensions.

items.title: YouTuber arrested after Indian finance influencer's suicide
items.feedTitle: V Harish: YouTuber arrested after Indian finance influencer's suicide
items.summary: A YouTuber has been arrested in connection with the death of V Harish, a popular Instagram finance influencer who ran 'Finance with Harish,' who was found dead on Tuesday. The incident highlights concerns about online harassment and toxic dynamics in the digital creator space. Harish's suicide triggered scrutiny into influencer relationships and online bullying.

immigration.title: Trump administration revokes record 300,000 visas since January
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Govt Cancels Record 300,000 Visas Since January 2025
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has revoked more than 300,000 visas since January 2025, surpassing any previous administration's rate of visa revocations. The revocations are part of a broader immigration enforcement agenda. The scale and speed of visa cancellations are unprecedented, affecting workers across multiple visa categories including H-1B holders.

immigration.title: Trump ends H-1B extension protections, finalizes work-permit restrictions
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Administration Moves to End H-1B Extension Protections, Finalizes Restrictions on Work Permit Renewals
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has moved to end H-1B extension protections and finalized restrictions on work permit renewals, proposed and not yet final. The changes would eliminate automatic extensions for H-1B visa holders and their dependents' work authorization documents. These restrictions significantly increase uncertainty for foreign workers and their families attempting to remain in the US.

immigration.title: US suspends labor certification for eight tech giants including Microsoft
immigration.feedTitle: US Suspends PERM Labor Certification for Eight Tech Giants, Blocking Green Card Pathway for Indian H-1B Holders
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has suspended the PERM labor certification program for eight major tech companies, blocking the green card pathway for H-1B workers at firms including Microsoft, Adobe, and others. The suspension, proposed and not yet final, is part of a crackdown on alleged H-1B visa abuse. Indian tech workers at these companies face significant delays in their permanent residency applications.

items.title: AI stocks weigh on markets as oil rises to five-month high
items.feedTitle: AI stocks weigh on markets Thursday as oil rises to highest price since May
items.summary: US and global stock markets fell Thursday as AI stocks weakened on spending concerns and oil climbed to its highest price since May. The Nasdaq led declines as technology sectors faced pressure. Broader market concerns about AI infrastructure costs combined with geopolitical tensions to drive the sell-off.

items.title: Sensex falls 460 points, Nifty slips below 22,700 as oil surges
items.feedTitle: Sensex Falls 460 Points, Nifty Drops Below 22,700 as Rising Oil Prices Extend Market Losing Streak
items.summary: India's Sensex fell 460 points and Nifty slipped below 22,700 as crude oil prices surged past $110, extending a three-day market losing streak. Rising oil prices are weighing on market sentiment and corporate earnings expectations. The index decline reflects investor anxiety over global economic headwinds.

items.title: Meta's credit risk indicator hits record high on AI spending
items.feedTitle: Meta's credit risk indicator hits record high on increased AI spending plan
items.summary: Meta's credit risk indicator has reached a record high as the company increases its AI infrastructure spending plans. Investors are concerned about the pace and scale of Meta's capital expenditures on artificial intelligence. The rising risk indicator suggests market doubts about the return on these massive investments.

items.title: Meta strikes deal with Zuckerberg over California wealth tax
items.feedTitle: Meta strikes deal with Mark Zuckerberg to help him foot billionaire tax bill
items.summary: Meta has agreed to help Mark Zuckerberg foot a potential California wealth tax targeting billionaires, with Zuckerberg committing to remain in the state for eight years. The deal aims to keep the Meta CEO in California despite proposed one-off 5% wealth tax on billionaires. The arrangement reflects concerns about executive departures amid wealth tax proposals.

items.title: Lam Research tumbles as chipmakers cite supply constraints
items.feedTitle: Chip Stock Rebound Comes Undone After Lam Research Stokes Spending Fears
items.summary: Chip stock rebound faltered as equipment maker Lam Research fell 9% citing supply chain constraints, dragging down the broader semiconductor sector. Applied Materials and ASML also declined on the disappointing guidance. The weakness in chip equipment stocks raises questions about the pace of AI infrastructure buildout.

US Nasdaq fell over 2% with tech stocks leading declines, while India's Nifty and Sensex dropped for a third straight session. cards.title: Constraints fuel creative breakthroughs
cards.insight: When resources or time are limited, creative thinking sharpens. Constraints force prioritization of only the most impactful ideas and eliminate wasteful exploration, making each creative effort count more.
cards.takeaway: Next time you face a deadline or budget limit, reframe it as a creative catalyst rather than a burden. Set tight boundaries on your project and watch how resourcefulness emerges.

cards.title: Recombination beats pure novelty
cards.insight: True creative breakthroughs rarely come from inventing something entirely new, but from combining existing ideas in fresh ways. The most creative work remixes the familiar into configurations others haven't yet imagined.
cards.takeaway: Study how different fields solve similar problems. Keep a list of interesting ideas from unrelated domains and look for unexpected connections that could reshape your own work.

cards.title: Iteration beats inspiration
cards.insight: Waiting for creative inspiration is a myth; consistent, unglamorous iteration is how great work emerges. Each cycle of feedback and refinement builds toward something meaningful that pure inspiration rarely delivers on its own.
cards.takeaway: Commit to a regular creative practice—daily writing, sketching, or experimentation—rather than chasing lightning-strike moments. Quality compounds through repetition.

cards.title: Collaboration amplifies individual creativity
cards.insight: Creative work flourishes in conversation. Others expose blind spots, challenge assumptions, and suggest directions the solo creator would never have pursued. Diversity of perspective is creative fuel.
cards.takeaway: Share incomplete drafts or rough ideas with collaborators earlier than feels comfortable. The discomfort of half-formed work often yields the most useful feedback and sparks.

ai.title: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek raises $15 billion funding round
ai.feedTitle: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek raises $15B in latest challenge to OpenAI, Anthropic: report
ai.summary: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the US ordered federal agencies to remove its technology citing national security concerns. The funding round underscores China's aggressive push into AI development despite US restrictions. DeepSeek's financing poses a direct challenge to OpenAI and Anthropic.

ai.title: OpenAI says GPT model helped find PHP security flaws
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI says GPT-5.6-Sol helped find the PHP flaws now shaking the internet
ai.summary: OpenAI says its GPT-5.6-Sol model helped discover the critical PHP vulnerabilities now causing a global cybersecurity scramble. The finding demonstrates AI's capability in identifying long-hidden security issues affecting 70% of websites worldwide. Governments and corporations worked throughout the night to patch the flaws, highlighting both AI's value and the risks of AI-dependent systems.

ai.title: Blackstone backs $18 billion debt deal for Anthropic AI chips
ai.feedTitle: Blackstone backs $18B debt deal for Anthropic's AI chips
ai.summary: Blackstone has backed an $18 billion debt deal to help Anthropic fund its AI chip infrastructure requirements. The financing underscores the enormous capital needs for AI model development and training. The deal reflects investor confidence in Anthropic's business model despite broader market jitters about AI spending.

ai.title: AI safety group finds flaws in OpenAI monitoring system
ai.feedTitle: AI safety group METR finds flaws in OpenAI’s internal monitoring system
ai.summary: The AI safety group METR has identified vulnerabilities in OpenAI's internal monitoring system designed to catch misbehaving AI agents. The findings suggest current safeguards may be inadequate to prevent harmful AI behavior. The flaws underscore ongoing challenges in developing robust AI oversight mechanisms.

ai.title: SpaceX's AI business beats expectations, drives profitability
ai.feedTitle: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
ai.summary: SpaceX achieved profitability in the third quarter with net income of $4.4 billion, with AI serving as a key growth engine for the aerospace company. The strong AI-driven results underscore the profitability potential of AI infrastructure and services. SpaceX's success contrasts with broader concerns about AI spending sustainability.
